Round-3 live retest. User picked UI/UX Designer at Flipkart Senior; AI ran as 'Senior Product Designer'. Six bugs across 5 turns:
  • T2 number-misbind: candidate said ₹40, AI says 'what's driving that ₹30 LPA figure' (asks about company's own offer instead of candidate's target). Anchor 'driving that ₹X' is NOT in the round-2 echo regex set.
  • T4 phantom number: 'The ₹30.4 LPA package' — ₹30.4 is the internal computed initialOffer leaking through (turn 1 displayed ₹30). 'the ₹X LPA package' isn't in the phantom-counter regex set (which only catches '… offer of ₹X').
  • T5 phantom counter: 'My current best offer … is a total CTC of ₹40 LPA' — AI never moved from ₹30. Round-2 regex requires 'current/latest/revised/etc.' but 'best' isn't in the keyword list. Also same turn has 'your target of ₹30.4 LPA' — number-echo with the swapped phantom number.
  • T6 premature close: 'put together the final numbers for you. HR send you a formal offer letter' — round-2 regex required 'let me put together' prefix and 'HR send you THE formal offer letter' (the vs a). Also hallucinated-employer '3INSYS' (candidate never said it; ASR garbled audio that the AI propagated as fact).
